name: IP Hearing Schedule Calendar
prompt:
In the ip_hearing_schedule folder on the desktop there is an Excel file named '11月第一周出庭排期表', which is a two-dimensional cross table: the columns are Monday through Friday, the rows are time periods, and the cells contain lawyer names.

Please convert the schedules containing '张伟' into an ics calendar file and ignore the other lawyers. Monday corresponds to November 6, 2023, and the following days advance in order. Use the time periods written in the first column of the table.

Use '[商标复审出庭]' uniformly as the calendar event title and write '国知局第一审理庭' as the location. Set a 30-minute advance reminder for each schedule. Name the output ics file '张伟_出庭日历.ics' and put it in the ip_hearing_schedule directory on the desktop.
